Congratulations to the winners of the Axis Bank Top 50 SMEs State Awards – Gujarat Edition. These exceptional businesses embody the ambition, innovation, and resilience that continue to drive India's growth story.
For decades, Axis Bank has partnered with India's MSMEs, supporting their growth through relevant financial solutions, industry insights, and meaningful engagement. The Top 50 SMEs State Awards, presented in association with India SME Forum, is an extension of that commitment, recognizing businesses that are driving innovation, creating impact, and contributing to India's economic progress.
The Gujarat edition marks the launch of a national platform dedicated to celebrating SME excellence. The inaugural edition brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and entrepreneurs to recognize businesses driving innovation, growth, and impact. We look forward to taking this platform across India and celebrating many more enterprises powering the nation's progress.

With India’s financial ecosystem undergoing rapid transformation, the next generation of financial crime risks calls for stronger institutional preparedness, deeper expertise and continued capacity building across the Reporting Entity ecosystem.

Against this backdrop, ARIFAC is hosting FinSight - an invitation-only leadership forum as part of Global Fintech Fest 2026, bringing senior AML/CFT leadership into a forward-looking dialogue on strengthening India’s financial integrity and resilience.

📍 9–10 September 2026 | Jio World Centre & Trident, BKC, Mumbai
FinSight@GFF2026 will convene Designated Directors and Principal Officers from across the Reporting Entity ecosystem, including banks, NBFCs and HFCs, UCBs, and payment system operators along with other financial sector participants.

The programme will feature regulatory dialogue, industry perspectives, leadership discussions, technology showcases and capacity-building engagements, with addresses and presentations by senior representatives from Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-IND), I4C, Reserve Bank of India (RBI), CERSAI India, Department of Telecommunications, Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) and National Payments Corporation Of India (NPCI).

The forum will explore emerging priorities across AML/CFT, financial intelligence, cyber-enabled financial crime and fraud prevention, with a focus on strengthening institutional capabilities and preparing the financial ecosystem for the evolving nature of financial crime.

Participation is by invite-only.
Designated Directors and Principal Officers interested in participating may submit an Expression of Interest via this form -
https://lnkd.in/dJEDU_w8 

Please Note: Submission of an EOI does not guarantee participation; confirmed invitations will be shared separately based on eligibility and relevancy to the forum.

Data science isn't just about writing code. It’s about how you think. 💡

Meet Ann Mathew, a Trainee Data Scientist at Equifax India who turned a steep corporate learning curve into global client impact.

Entering the complex world of credit risk, Ann didn’t stay behind the scenes. In just her first year, she stepped up to drive a major Middle East client engagement, translating complex business requirements into actionable data for executive decision-making.

Her impact didn't stop there. Ann quickly scaled her skills to:
🔹 Optimize enterprise efficiency through large-scale SAS to Python automations.
🔹 Contribute to strict regulatory scoring models to strengthen financial compliance.
🔹 Explore supervised and unsupervised learning techniques for custom risk models.

How do you master that level of modeling so early in your career? A culture that values problem-solving over raw syntax.

"What makes Equifax stand out is its strong emphasis on the thought process," Ann shares. "It’s not just about technical skills; it’s about how you build business logic. When I was unsure, my managers took the time to break down complex concepts, building my confidence to deliver."
